name: Hitsteps for MainWP
author: Hitsteps

sections.description:
Hitsteps for MainWP is free. It runs on your MainWP Dashboard.

  • Sign in to your Hitsteps account once. Your password is sent to Hitsteps one time and is not stored. Hitsteps returns a connection that lasts 90 days. Disconnect removes the local connection and asks Hitsteps to revoke it. If Hitsteps cannot be reached, the old connection expires within 90 days.
  • Connect all sites goes through MainWP’s own site list, ten sites at a time. Each site without a Hitsteps code is added to your Hitsteps account, within your plan’s site limit, and MainWP saves the site code on that site. A site that is already in your account gets its existing code back, so it is never added twice.
  • A site that already has a Hitsteps code keeps it. This add-on never replaces it, because that code may belong to your client’s own Hitsteps account.
  • A MainWP sync refreshes last-30-day visitors, page views and top pages for each connected site. “Open in Hitsteps” opens that site’s full Hitsteps dashboard.
  • MainWP Pro Reports can show [hitsteps.visitors], [hitsteps.pageviews] and [hitsteps.toppages]. Each report gets only its own site’s numbers.

When your plan is full, the site shows “Site limit reached” with a link to the Hitsteps plan page. There is no checkout inside MainWP.

Child sites need the Hitsteps plugin (Hitsteps Web Analytics), version 6.0.1 or later, from WordPress.org. You can install it on all sites at once with MainWP’s plugin installer. Child sites store only their own site code. The agency password and the connection never go to them.

External services

This add-on connects your MainWP Dashboard to the hosted Hitsteps analytics service at https://www.hitsteps.com/api/wp-mainwp.php. It sends:

  • when you sign in: your Hitsteps email and password, once, to get a connection;
  • when you press Connect all sites: that connection, and each child site’s address and name, to add the site to your account;
  • when you press Disconnect or delete the add-on: that connection, to end it.

Child sites, through the Hitsteps plugin, send their own site code to the same address to read their last-30-day numbers. Review the Hitsteps Terms of Service and the Hitsteps Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. On your MainWP Dashboard, install and activate Hitsteps for MainWP.
  2. On your child sites, install and activate the Hitsteps plugin, version 6.0.1 or later.
  3. Open Hitsteps for MainWP in the MainWP Dashboard, sign in with your Hitsteps email and password, and press Connect all sites.
  4. Run a MainWP sync to refresh the numbers.
  5. Optional: in Pro Reports, add the custom tokens hitsteps.visitors, hitsteps.pageviews and hitsteps.toppages to a report.
sections.faq:
Does this cost anything?

The add-on is free. Connected sites count toward your Hitsteps plan’s site limit, the same as sites you add in Hitsteps.

Is my Hitsteps password stored?

No. It is sent to Hitsteps once, when you sign in. The MainWP Dashboard keeps only the 90-day connection, and Hitsteps keeps only a fingerprint of it.

What happens to a client site that already uses Hitsteps?

It keeps its code and keeps tracking into the account it already uses. Connect all sites does not add it to your account and does not change its code.

Which period do the numbers cover?

The newest 30 days of data, as of the latest Connect all sites or MainWP sync.
